tagline: Fisker Owners Association — check if your Ocean is ready for the Marlin update
intro_heading: Is your Fisker Ocean ready for Marlin?
intro_text: Export a diagnostics report from the Ocean Link Pro (OLP) app and upload it here. We compare every control module's software version against the Marlin requirements and tell you immediately whether your car qualifies, or which modules need a targeted update first.
consent_label: I agree that the report and my VIN are stored to build anonymous fleet statistics for the association.
consent_hint: Optional. Without consent the report is analyzed in memory only and nothing is stored.
error_parse: The file could not be read as an OLP diagnostics report: {reason}
error_too_large: The file is larger than the 15 MB limit.
error_rate_limited: Too many uploads in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
verdict_ready_text: All required modules meet the 2.1 minimum levels — your car is a full 100% 2.1 car and can be updated directly to Marlin.
verdict_zebra_text: Your car is a zebra and will not successfully be updated to Marlin — the ECU software versions listed below belong to SW 2.1, 2.0 or even earlier. Have the full 2.2 SW update performed before attempting the Marlin update:
extra_modules_title: Other modules in the report (no Marlin requirement)
stats_intro: Aggregated from reports uploaded with consent. Only the latest report per vehicle counts.
stats_empty: No data yet — statistics appear once members upload reports with consent.
privacy_text: This portal is run by volunteers for members of the Fisker Owners Association. When you upload a report it is analyzed on our server and the result is shown to you. If you do NOT tick the consent box, the report is processed in memory only and nothing is stored. If you tick the box, we store the report file, your VIN and the module versions so the association can build aggregated statistics (number of unique cars, version distribution). Statistics never show individual VINs. No data is shared with third parties and no tracking cookies are used (only a cookie remembering your language choice). To have stored data removed, contact the association. For every upload we also record an anonymous usage entry — country (from Cloudflare), language, and whether the car was ready — never the VIN, the report, or your IP address.
footer_disclaimer: Community tool — not affiliated with Fisker Inc. Verify results with the association before scheduling updates.
alpha_text: This portal is under development. The requirements it compares against are an unconfirmed draft, so the result may be wrong. Do not make decisions based on this report yet.
front_requirements_intro: Each module must be at least at the level below to count as {profile}. Requirements version: {version}.
parse_too_large: The file is larger than the 15 MB limit.
parse_bad_pdf: The PDF content could not be read.
parse_unreadable: The file is neither a PDF nor readable text.
parse_no_header: Could not find the heading “ECU Software Version Report” — is this a diagnostics report exported from OceanLink Pro?
parse_no_vin: No VIN line (VIN: <17 characters>) was found in the report.
parse_no_modules: No ECU sections were found in the report.
ready_22_note: Note: a direct update from 2.1 to Marlin will still NOT update the ECUs below — they belong to the 2.2 update (a mandatory NHTSA recall in North America that most European cars never received). The car will function fine, but these ECUs will remain on their current versions:
vcu24_notice: Notice for all users already on VCU 2.4 (from Marlin or otherwise): make sure you inform anyone updating your car to 2.2 that you ALREADY have it. There is no backward option or compatibility from VCU 2.4 (Marlin) to VCU 2.3 (2.2/2.2.3).
trim_unknown_note: The trim could not be determined from the VIN, so every module is treated as required (including the rear motor controller).
parse_too_many_pages: The PDF has too many pages to be an OLP diagnostics report.
